functions.name: role_catalog_fingerprint
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_catalog_fingerprint()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT md5(coalesce((SELECT string_agg(to_jsonb(r)::text,'|' ORDER BY id) FROM app_roles r),'')||private.org_fingerprint()||coalesce((SELECT string_agg(to_jsonb(s)::text,'|' ORDER BY id) FROM org_position_slots s),'')||coalesce((SELECT string_agg(to_jsonb(s)::text,'|' ORDER BY user_id,specialty_id) FROM mkt_staff_specialties s),''))
$function$

functions.name: role_catalog_change
role_catalog_system_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_catalog_system_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF OLD.id='role-super-admin' AND (NEW.permissions IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.permissions OR NEW.name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.name OR NOT NEW.is_system OR NEW.catalog_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.catalog_state OR NEW.role_kind IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.role_kind) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Role Super Admin không được thay đổi qua cổng thông thường.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NEW.role_kind='marketing_task' AND OLD.role_kind IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.role_kind AND private.role_in_use(OLD.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Không đổi loại Role đang có nguồn sử dụng.'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW; END $function$

functions.name: role_editor_validate
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.role_editor_validate(kind text, next_permissions text[], previous_permissions text[])
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$ BEGIN IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(coalesce(next_permissions,'{}')) p WHERE NOT p=ANY(coalesce(previous_permissions,'{}')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.permission_editor_policy() s WHERE s.key=p AND CASE WHEN kind='marketing_task' THEN private.mkt_specialty_permission_ready(p) AND s.scope<>'unit' ELSE private.org_role_permission_ready(p) END)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Quyền mới chưa có phạm vi an toàn; giữ cấu hình hiện tại hoặc chọn quyền đã kiểm chứng.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF; END $function$
